combo_label: Around the House × Sewing & Knitting × Roald Dahl

entries.clue: Cocoa sweet, churned by waterfall, that runs as a river through the factory
Bedridden old fellow who leaps up to join a golden-ticket factory tour
Ball of snipped wool ends, wound on two card rings, that tops a bobble hat
Long-billed bird whose pouch does the bucket work for window cleaners
Sitting room where the telly faces the seats and evenings drift by
Two- or three-seater with an arm at each end, sagging in the middle
Cut shapes of cloth laid on a background and secured all round the edge
Pins at the end of a flex, pushed into a socket for power
Ticket winner who demands a trained squirrel and goes down the rubbish chute
Fold pressed into a fabric to give fullness, as down a school skirt
